entities.summary: The Tao Te Ching or Tao Te King or Dào Dé Jīng, often Laozi in Chinese and scholarship, is an ancient Chinese classic text, becoming a foundational work of Taoism. Central to both philosophical and religious Taoism, it has been highly influential on Chinese philosophy and religious practice in general.
